name: @oxytocin/relay
description: Hands a project's work from one AI agent to the next: on to another agent when an account nears its limit, or to a reviewer after each change

oxytocin.description: Hands work from one AI agent to the next in a project: when an agent finishes its turn with its 5-hour limit nearly used, the next agent continues; or a reviewer agent reviews each change. One short prompt per hand-off, nothing else.
